page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with two marginal notes in the right margin beside the first and the fifth lines of the column.

main_text.l: Atq; hæc de primo nuncupationum &
dedicationum sint genere dicta. Reliquum
est, de altero uagatur: quod & certæ cu-
iusdam personæ θεοσφωνημ[?] compellatio-
nem, & alia continet, quæ in eiuscemodi
dedicationibus obseruanda sunt. Suppe-
ditant verò generis huius exempla egre-
gia θεσμοῖς[?] principia atque vestibula li-
brorum ad amicos à Cicerone missorum:
quæ sunt aut ἀπολογικὰ[?], & causas conti-
nent, vel μεσσοφωνήσεως[?] dedicationis atque
compellationis eorum, sub quorum no-
mine in lucem scripta prodeunt. 1. de ora-
tore. 3. de finibus. 1. offic. de senectute,
in paradoxis: vel suscepti in manus ope-
ris easque petitas: à voluntate & petitio-
ne eius cui illud inscribimus. libro 1. ad
Herennium primo de oratore: in orato-
re perfecto: Topicis: à materia & argu-
menti utilitate. libro 1. ad Heren. 1. de in-
uentione. 1. de oratore: in oratore perfe-
cto: in topicis. 3. & 5. Tuscul. 1. de natura.
1. de diuinatione. ab eiusdem difficulta-
te. 1. de oratore: in oratore perfecto. 1. de
natura: de facto: à persona autoris. 1. Acad.
quæst. 1. 2. 5. Tusculan. de diuinatione. 3.
officiorum. Ab exemplis aliorum. secun-
do de inuentione. 1. Acad. quæst.
4. Tusc. 1.

page.notes: Marginal note 1, right, beside the first lines: "De altero genere dedicationum." (set in italic, with the hyphen at "dedica-tionum" as printed). Marginal note 2, right, beside the dedicationibus line: "Sententiæ ꝙ[?] in librorum principiis apud Ciceronem reperiuntur." The mark before "in" is doubtful. Greek words are doubtful: "θεοσφωνημ", "θεσμοῖς", "ἀπολογικὰ" and "μεσσοφωνήσεως" are my best reading of the scan and are marked [?]. The word "secundo" on the line "secun-do" is doubtful; it may read "fecundo" in print. A small bracket-like mark under the last line is not text and has been left out. The text is set as one printed paragraph; the narrow Latin references are part of the running text, not notes.
